source: Ureshino et al. (2026), Bayesian Doppler Imaging: Simultaneous Inference of Surface Maps and Geometric Parameters (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08544), Table of posterior estimates for Luhman 16B
band: VLT/CRIRES, 2.304-2.316 um (the CO band head); not a visible band

u1.cell: 2 sqrt(q1) q2 (Kipping 2013) of the published medians; uncertainty half its spread over the corners of the 16-84 % ranges

u2.cell: sqrt(q1) (1 - 2 q2) (Kipping 2013) of the published medians; uncertainty half its spread over the corners of the 16-84 % ranges

note: Fitted with the surface map, in Kipping's parametrisation, to the CRIRES spectra of the dwarf itself; the only limb law measured for it. It is an infrared law: the visible limb is not measured, and no model table reaches a 1,261 K dwarf. The edge keeps 1 - u1 - u2 = 0.099 of the centre's brightness.
